sample_unit: LLM responses (4 models x 2 gender prompts)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade level) of LLM responses to a simulated 14-year-old patient
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid scores ranged 5.4-10.8, described as suitable for high school to college level; some outputs are above a typical 14-year-old's reading level.
links.quote: Flesch-Kincaid scores indicated a readability level suitable for high school to college (5.4-10.8).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four commercial LLMs answering patient-simulated queries about Stargardt's disease, assessing readability, content depth, and similarity without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
